epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase backend application uptime from 0% to 100% on port 18080
requirements: R1: The backend application must start successfully and respond to HTTP health checks on port 18080.

slices.title: Patch backend startup error and restore health check
slices.jtbd: When implementing the patch for this epic, I want to resolve the connection refused error on port 18080, so that the application startup remediation is complete.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the backend application is launched in the target environment
When a client requests the /health endpoint on port 18080
Then the application must return a successful HTTP response without connection refusal
Given the patch is applied
When the system tests are executed
Then the tests confirm the application binds to the correct port and starts without failure
Given the patch is applied
When the application is started
Then there should be no exceptions logged during startup initialization
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease backend startup failures from 1 to 0 per deployment
